title: Mathematics, B.S. (Behrend)
notes: Pattern B (genuinely separate curriculum from University Park's Mathematics B.S., MATH-2026.json) -- confirmed 2026-08-27 by directly reading Behrend's own bulletin page and comparing course-by-course against the UP plan's General Mathematics option. Real, load-bearing differences: (1) Behrend requires ENGL 202C outright (UP treats 202A/B/C/D as interchangeable); (2) Behrend requires CMPSC 121 AND 122 as prescribed common courses (UP's General Mathematics option only requires one intro programming course); (3) Behrend requires STAT 301 and STAT 401 as common prescribed courses -- neither appears anywhere in UP's plan; (4) Behrend structures its major into four distinct, named Option tracks (Applied Mathematics, Business, Computer Science, Pure Mathematics) each with its own elective-group requirements -- UP's General Mathematics option has no such named-track structure at all; (5) MATH 220 is 2cr at Behrend vs UP's implicit 3cr treatment; (6) Behrend requires a lab-science sequence (8-9cr) that UP's plan doesn't require. This is Applied Mathematics option (chosen because it's the only one of the four with a fully detailed 8-semester Suggested Academic Plan published on the bulletin page, same judgment call already used for MATH-2026.json choosing 'General Mathematics' among UP's own multiple options). Total program credits per the bulletin: 121 (matches this plan's own semester sum). 'Group A' (select 5 of MATH 310/412/449/455/456/482, STAT 414/461/462/464/466 -- 15cr), 'Group B' (select 2 of MATH 421/426/427/429/435/436/465 -- 6cr) and the 'CMPSC 221 or higher (except CMPSC 360)' requirement (2 courses, 6cr) are the bulletin's own real, closed lists, wired as repeated fixed-option course items (Group A/B) and an open_elective restricted to CMPSC only (Group C, min level 221, CMPSC 360 excluded) respectively -- the engine's own option-pool de-duplication (see planner_engine._ranked_options) guarantees 5/2/2 distinct picks since each pool has more members than needed. The bulletin's 'School-approved supporting courses' (9cr total, 3 slots) and the 8-9cr 'Science Sequence (select one pair: BIOL 110 & BIOL 220W; CHEM 110/111/112/113; PHYS 211 & PHYS 212; or PHYS 250 & PHYS 251)' are left as generic, unenumerated slots rather than guessed at a single sequence/list -- no Behrend-published 'school-approved' course list could be found, and forcing one specific science sequence when the bulletin genuinely offers 4 equally-valid options would misrepresent student choice (same 'never fabricate' judgment call already used for PLSC's 'Related course in consultation with adviser' and HIST's 'World Language Level 1/2/3' slots). Added a real, minimal STAT 301 catalog entry (stat_catalog.json) -- it's a real, active Behrend requirement (also required in Behrend's own Statistics Minor, confirmed via that program's real PDF) that is not published in the university-wide undergraduate course-description bulletin, evidently a branch-campus-only course number; not fabricated, see that catalog entry's own note for the sourcing. Entrance to major requires 2.0 GPA plus C-or-better in MATH 140/141, not modeled directly (same limitation as every other major's GPA/grade-floor entrance requirement in this repo).
